result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure: its headline and promo code text are white on a very pale mint background and are nearly unreadable. No other clear visual defects were found; clipped carousel items and the cut-off bottom card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint-green background. The text is almost invisible, so users are likely to miss the offer and the promo code.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the pale background, or darken the banner background to a saturated green so white text meets WCAG contrast (at least 4.5:1).
